== Dialogue ==
: ''"With all the storms we get here, someone should find a way to harness that power. So I'm building a machine to capture lightning. I've heard copper attracts lightning, but I'm no miner. I'm a sage! To get enough copper for my marvellous energy-machine, I'm melting down copper coins. Those corsairs certainly have enough.... I say, if you happen upon any corsair coins, I'll gladly take them from you. Bring me 3 [[Copper Shilling]]s and I'll gladly reward you with:"''
{{Nosale dialogue|Copper Shillings}}
